neighbours.label: The demonstratives ' this' and ' here' in running text; the same sentences with 'the', 'it' or 'there' stay low.
fire: As the reviewer explained in this essay, the bridge is unsafe.
She told me, more than once, that this was a trick.
A cold wind had risen and the waters here were rough.
The editor rejected the point made in this chapter of the report.
We walked along the shore, and the rocks here looked sharp.
He keeps saying, to anyone at all, that this is his land.
As the guide noted in this brochure, the caves are closed.
The soil here is thin, and most farmers grow only rye.
